passages.title: 我的家
sentences: 我叫王明，我是学生。
My name is Wang Ming. I am a student.
我家在北京。
My home is in Beijing.
我家有三个人：爸爸、妈妈和我。
There are three people in my family: Dad, Mum and me.
我爸爸是医生，他在医院工作。
My dad is a doctor. He works at a hospital.
我妈妈是汉语老师，她很喜欢她的学生。
My mum is a Chinese teacher. She likes her students very much.
我们家有狗，没有猫。
We have a dog at home, but no cat.
星期六和星期日，我们都在家。
On Saturday and Sunday we are all at home.
爸爸做菜，妈妈看书，我看电视。
Dad cooks, Mum reads and I watch TV.
下午我们去商店买水果。
In the afternoon we go to the shop to buy fruit.
我很爱我的家。
I love my family very much.

questions.q: 王明的爸爸在哪儿工作？
questions.en: Where does Wang Ming's dad work?
Wang Ming's mum is a doctor.
There is a dog in Wang Ming's home.

questions.q: 在家的时候，爸爸做什么？
questions.en: What does Dad do when they are at home?

questions.q: 下午他们去商店买什么？
questions.en: What do they buy at the shop in the afternoon?

passages.title: 在饭馆
sentences: 中午，李文和朋友林娜去一个饭馆。
At noon Li Wen and her friend Lin Na went to a restaurant.
服务员：“你们好！请坐。你们想吃什么？”
Waiter: "Hello! Please sit down. What would you like to eat?"
李文：“我想吃米饭和这个菜。”
Li Wen: "I'd like rice and this dish."
林娜：“我不吃米饭，我想吃这个中国菜。”
Lin Na: "I don't eat rice. I'd like this Chinese dish."
服务员：“你们喝什么？我们的茶很好。”
Waiter: "What will you drink? Our tea is very good."
李文：“好，我们喝茶。”
Li Wen: "OK, we'll have tea."
菜很多，她们都很喜欢。
There was a lot of food, and they both liked it very much.
李文：“服务员，多少钱？”
Li Wen: "Waiter, how much is it?"
服务员：“八十九块。”
Waiter: "Eighty-nine yuan."
林娜：“今天我请你。”
Lin Na: "Today it's my treat."
李文：“谢谢你！”林娜：“不客气。”
Li Wen: "Thank you!" Lin Na: "You're welcome."

questions.en: What does Lin Na not eat?
They drank tea.
How much did their meal cost?
Today Lin Na treats Li Wen.

passages.title: 天气冷了
sentences: 女儿，你在学校好吗？
Daughter, are you well at school?
今天北京很冷。
It's very cold in Beijing today.
我看了电视，明天会下雨。
I watched TV. It will rain tomorrow.
明天你去学校的时候，请多穿衣服。
When you go to school tomorrow, please wear more clothes.
你下午几点回家？
What time are you coming home in the afternoon?
下午爸爸去学校，和你一起回来。
In the afternoon Dad will go to the school and come back with you.
今天我做了你喜欢的菜。
Today I made the dish you like.
回家的时候，给妈妈打电话。
When you are coming home, call Mum.
我和爸爸都很想你。
Dad and I both miss you very much.

questions.en: What will the weather be like tomorrow?

questions.q: 妈妈请女儿明天多穿衣服。
questions.en: Mum asks her daughter to wear more clothes tomorrow.
Who is going to the school in the afternoon?

questions.q: 妈妈今天做的菜，女儿不喜欢。
questions.en: The daughter does not like the dish Mum made today.

questions.q: 女儿回家的时候做什么？
questions.en: What does the daughter do when she is coming home?

passages.title: 买衣服
sentences: 星期六上午，刘芳和妈妈去商店买衣服。
On Saturday morning Liu Fang and her mum went to a shop to buy clothes.
商店里有很多衣服，都很漂亮。
There were lots of clothes in the shop, all very pretty.
刘芳看见一件衣服，她很喜欢。
Liu Fang saw a piece of clothing she liked very much.
她问：“你好，这件衣服多少钱？”
She asked: "Hello, how much is this?"
“三百八十块。”
"Three hundred and eighty yuan."
刘芳想：“太贵了！”
Liu Fang thought: "That's too expensive!"
妈妈看见了一件，那件一百九十块，很漂亮。
Mum saw another one. That one was 190 yuan and very pretty.
刘芳买了妈妈看见的那件。
Liu Fang bought the one Mum saw.
中午，她们在商店前面的饭馆吃了米饭。
At noon they had rice at the restaurant in front of the shop.

questions.en: Who did Liu Fang go to the shop with?
There were few clothes in the shop.
How much was the clothing Liu Fang bought?

questions.q: 中午她们在一个饭馆吃了米饭。
questions.en: At noon they ate rice at a restaurant.

passages.title: 明天看电影吗？
sentences: 林娜：陈杰，明天是星期六，你想去看电影吗？
Lin Na: Chen Jie, tomorrow is Saturday. Do you want to see a film?
陈杰：想！什么电影？
Chen Jie: Yes! Which film?
林娜：一个中国电影，很多人都喜欢。
Lin Na: A Chinese film. Lots of people like it.
陈杰：几点的电影？
Chen Jie: What time is the film?
林娜：下午三点。
Lin Na: Three in the afternoon.
陈杰：好。我们坐出租车去吗？
Chen Jie: OK. Shall we go by taxi?
林娜：不坐出租车。你两点来我家，我们一起去。
Lin Na: No taxi. Come to my place at two and we'll go together.
陈杰：我的同学王丽也想去，她能和我们去吗？
Chen Jie: My classmate Wang Li wants to go too. Can she come with us?
林娜：能！我们三个人去。
Lin Na: Sure! The three of us will go.

questions.en: Which day are they going to see the film?
What time is the film?

questions.q: 他们坐出租车去看电影。
questions.en: They take a taxi to the film.
Wang Li wants to see the film too.
How many people are going to the film?

passages.title: 你在哪儿？
sentences: 爸爸：喂，儿子，你在哪儿？
Dad: Hello, son, where are you?
儿子：喂，爸爸！我在学校。
Son: Hello, Dad! I'm at school.
爸爸：现在五点了，你怎么没回家？
Dad: It's five o'clock now. Why haven't you come home?
儿子：我在学校和同学学习汉语呢。
Son: I'm studying Chinese with classmates at school.
爸爸：你什么时候回来？
Dad: When are you coming back?
儿子：六点回家。
Son: I'll be home at six.
爸爸：你妈妈今天不在家，她去北京了。
Dad: Your mum isn't home today. She has gone to Beijing.
爸爸：我们去饭馆吃，怎么样？
Dad: How about we eat at a restaurant?
儿子：太好了！我想吃中国菜。
Son: Great! I want Chinese food.
爸爸：六点我去学校，我们坐出租车去饭馆。
Dad: I'll come to the school at six, and we'll take a taxi to the restaurant.

questions.en: Where is the son now?
The son is watching a film at school.
Where did Mum go today?

questions.q: 儿子想去饭馆吃中国菜。
questions.en: The son wants to eat Chinese food at a restaurant.
What do they take to the restaurant?

passages.title: 我的中国同学
sentences: 我叫安娜，现在我在北京学习汉语。
My name is Anna. I'm studying Chinese in Beijing now.
我们学校有很多中国学生。
There are many Chinese students at our school.
昨天，我认识了一个中国同学，她叫周婷。
Yesterday I met a Chinese classmate. Her name is Zhou Ting.
周婷二十一岁，她很漂亮。
Zhou Ting is twenty-one. She is very pretty.
她爸爸是医生，妈妈是老师。
Her dad is a doctor and her mum is a teacher.
下午，我们在学校后面的饭馆喝茶。
In the afternoon we drank tea at the restaurant behind the school.
我的汉语不太好，周婷说话很慢。
My Chinese isn't very good. Zhou Ting speaks slowly.
她在我的书上写了她的名字。
She wrote her name in my book.
认识她，我很高兴。
I'm very happy to know her.
明天我们去看电影。
Tomorrow we are going to see a film.

questions.en: Anna is studying in China now.
How old is Zhou Ting?
Zhou Ting's mum is a doctor.
Where did they drink tea in the afternoon?

questions.q: 周婷在安娜的书上写了什么？
questions.en: What did Zhou Ting write in Anna's book?

passages.title: 火车站的小商店
sentences: 我们的商店在火车站前面。
Our shop is in front of the railway station.
星期一到星期日，商店都开。
The shop is open Monday to Sunday.
从上午七点开到晚上十点。
It is open from seven in the morning until ten at night.
我们这里有水果、茶、水和很多吃的东西。
We have fruit, tea, water and lots of things to eat.
苹果很好，三块钱一个。
The apples are very good, three yuan each.
我们没有衣服，没有书。
We don't have clothes or books.
我们这里有桌子和椅子，你能在这里喝茶、吃东西。
We have tables and chairs here, so you can drink tea and eat here.
谢谢你来我们的商店！
Thank you for coming to our shop!

questions.en: Where is the shop?
This shop is open on Sundays.
What time does the shop open in the morning?
How much is one apple?
You can buy clothes in this shop.

passages.title: 去北京
sentences: 下个月我和爸爸妈妈去北京。
Next month I'm going to Beijing with my mum and dad.
我们家在上海，我们坐飞机去。
We live in Shanghai, and we're flying there.
我们坐上午十点的飞机。
We're taking the 10 a.m. plane.
在北京，我们住在爸爸的朋友家。
In Beijing we'll stay at Dad's friend's home.
他的家在火车站后面，很大。
His home is behind the railway station. It's very big.
爸爸的朋友有一个女儿，她八岁。
Dad's friend has a daughter who is eight.
我想和她一起去看看北京的学校和商店。
I want to go and see Beijing's schools and shops with her.
北京下个月很冷，我们都要多穿衣服。
Beijing is very cold next month, so we all need to wear more clothes.

questions.en: What time is their plane?

questions.q: 在北京，他们住在饭馆里。
questions.en: In Beijing they will stay in a restaurant.
Dad's friend's home is very big.
How old is Dad's friend's daughter?

passages.title: 我的朋友
sentences: 我有一个好朋友，他叫赵强。
I have a good friend called Zhao Qiang.
我们是同学。
We are classmates.
赵强很喜欢猫，他家里有猫，没有狗。
Zhao Qiang loves cats. He has cats at home but no dog.
我不喜欢猫，我喜欢狗。
I don't like cats. I like dogs.
赵强会做菜，他做的中国菜很好吃。
Zhao Qiang can cook. The Chinese food he makes is delicious.
星期日中午，我去他家吃他做的菜。
At noon on Sunday I go to his home to eat the food he cooks.
下午我们在他家看电影。
In the afternoon we watch films at his home.
赵强的爸爸是老师，妈妈在一个商店工作。
Zhao Qiang's dad is a teacher, and his mum works in a shop.
我们认识十年了。
We have known each other for ten years.

questions.en: Zhao Qiang and I are classmates.
What does Zhao Qiang have at home?

questions.en: Zhao Qiang's mum works in a shop.

passages.title: 看医生
sentences: 星期一上午，王丽生病了，她去医院看医生。
On Monday morning Wang Li was ill, so she went to the hospital to see a doctor.
医生：“你好！请坐。你怎么了？”
Doctor: "Hello! Please sit down. What's wrong?"
王丽：“我很冷，不想吃东西。”
Wang Li: "I feel very cold and I don't want to eat."
医生：“你昨天吃了什么？喝了什么？”
Doctor: "What did you eat and drink yesterday?"
王丽：“昨天中午我在饭馆喝了很多冷水。”
Wang Li: "Yesterday at noon I drank lots of cold water at a restaurant."
医生：“没关系。你回家多喝热水，多睡觉。”
Doctor: "It's nothing serious. Go home, drink lots of hot water and sleep a lot."
医生：“今天和明天不能去工作。”
Doctor: "Don't go to work today or tomorrow."
医生：“星期三上午你再来看看。”
Doctor: "Come back for a check on Wednesday morning."

questions.en: Which day did Wang Li go to the hospital?
Wang Li really wants to eat.

questions.q: 昨天中午王丽在哪儿喝了很多冷水？
questions.en: Where did Wang Li drink lots of cold water yesterday at noon?

questions.q: 王丽今天和明天都能去工作。
questions.en: Wang Li can go to work today and tomorrow.

questions.q: 星期三上午王丽做什么？
questions.en: What does Wang Li do on Wednesday morning?

passages.title: 我的星期日
sentences: 星期日我不去学校。
I don't go to school on Sundays.
上午九点，我在家里喝茶。
At nine in the morning I drink tea at home.
十点，我和妈妈去商店买东西。
At ten my mum and I go shopping.
我们买了苹果和茶。
We buy apples and tea.
中午十二点我们回家，妈妈做菜。
At twelve noon we go home and Mum cooks.
下午一点，我在家里睡觉。
At one in the afternoon I have a sleep at home.
下午三点，我去同学家学习汉语。
At three in the afternoon I go to a classmate's home to study Chinese.
同学的家在医院后面，很近。
My classmate's home is behind the hospital, very close.
下午六点我回家看电视。
At six in the afternoon I go home and watch TV.

questions.q: 上午十点，我和谁去商店？
questions.en: Who do I go to the shop with at ten in the morning?
We bought apples at the shop.
What do I do at one in the afternoon?
What do I go and do at three in the afternoon?
My classmate's home is in front of the hospital.

passages.title: 我学习汉语
sentences: 我叫安迪，我是美国人。
My name is Andy. I'm American.
我在北京学习汉语，我很喜欢汉语。
I'm studying Chinese in Beijing, and I like Chinese very much.
汉语的字很多，有的字很漂亮。
Chinese has a lot of characters, and some of them are very beautiful.
我的老师是北京人，她说话很好听。
My teacher is from Beijing, and her speech sounds lovely.
上午我在学校读书、写字。
In the morning I read and write characters at school.
下午我和中国朋友说话。
In the afternoon I talk with Chinese friends.
我现在能读一些汉语书了。
Now I can read some Chinese books.
我也会写我的中国名字。
I can also write my Chinese name.
我想在中国工作。
I want to work in China.

questions.q: 上午安迪在哪儿读书、写字？

questions.q: 现在安迪会读一点汉语书。
questions.en: Andy can now read some Chinese books.

passages.title: 这个饭馆怎么样？
sentences: 我家前面有一个小饭馆。
There is a small restaurant in front of my home.
饭馆不大，饭馆里有十张桌子。
The restaurant isn't big. It has ten tables.
这里的菜很好吃，米饭也很好吃。
The dishes here are delicious, and so is the rice.
我很喜欢这里的中国菜。
I really like the Chinese food here.
三个人吃，一百多块钱。
A meal for three costs just over a hundred yuan.
星期六和星期日，很多人来这里吃。
On Saturdays and Sundays lots of people come here to eat.
我爸爸很喜欢这里的茶，我妈妈很喜欢这里的米饭。
My dad really likes the tea here, and my mum really likes the rice.
我想，你会喜欢这个饭馆。
I think you'll like this restaurant.

questions.en: How many tables are in the restaurant?

How much does a meal for three cost?

questions.q: 星期日，很多人去这个饭馆。
questions.en: On Sundays lots of people go to this restaurant.

questions.q: 爸爸喜欢这个饭馆的什么？
questions.en: What does Dad like about this restaurant?

passages.title: 我的房间
sentences: 这是我的房间。
This is my room.
房间不大，很漂亮。
The room isn't big, but it's very nice.
房间里有桌子、椅子和电脑。
There is a table, a chair and a computer in the room.
桌子上有我的电脑和一些书。
My computer and some books are on the table.
我的狗在桌子后面睡觉。
My dog is sleeping behind the table.
椅子上有我的衣服。
My clothes are on the chair.
我的杯子在电脑前面，杯子里有茶。
My cup is in front of the computer, and there is tea in it.
我在这里学习、写字、看电影。
I study, write and watch films here.
我也在这里睡觉。
I sleep here too.
我很喜欢我的房间。
I really like my room.

questions.en: What is on the table?
The dog is sleeping on the chair.
What is on the chair?
There is water in the cup.

passages.title: 妹妹的生日
sentences: 今天是十月八号，是我妹妹的生日。
Today is 8 October, my younger sister's birthday.
妹妹十岁了，她非常高兴。
My sister is ten now, and she is very happy.
早上，妈妈给她做了一个大蛋糕。
In the morning Mum made her a big cake.
爸爸送了她一块红手表。
Dad gave her a red watch.
我送她一本书，因为她很喜欢读书。
I gave her a book, because she loves reading.
下午，妹妹的同学都来我们家了。
In the afternoon all my sister's classmates came to our home.
她们唱歌、跳舞，玩得非常快乐。
They sang, danced and had a wonderful time.
晚上，我们一起吃蛋糕。
In the evening we ate the cake together.
大家一起给妹妹唱歌。
Everyone sang to my sister together.
妹妹笑着告诉我们：“这是我最快乐的生日！”
My sister smiled and told us: "This is my happiest birthday!"
我希望妹妹每个生日都很快乐。
I hope every one of my sister's birthdays is a happy one.

questions.en: How old is the sister now?

The sister loves reading.

questions.q: 妹妹的同学下午来了我们家。

What does everyone do in the evening?

Hello everyone! This is Teacher Wang.
这个星期六上午，我们一起去打篮球。
This Saturday morning we're going to play basketball together.
早上八点，请大家到教室来。
Please come to the classroom at eight in the morning.
我们从学校走去，路不远，走二十五分钟就到了。
We'll walk from the school. It isn't far, just twenty-five minutes on foot.
请大家穿白衣服。
Please wear white clothes.
请大家准备好水，那里没有卖水的商店。
Please bring water with you. There is no shop selling water there.
打篮球以后，我们去学校旁边的饭馆吃羊肉。

星期六下雨，我们就不去了。
If it rains on Saturday, we won't go.
想去的同学，请在星期四晚上以前告诉我。
If you want to go, please tell me before Thursday evening.
谢谢大家！

questions.en: What time should they be at the classroom?

questions.q: 想去打篮球的人，星期五告诉老师就可以。

sentences: 我叫孙浩，我在一个公司上班。
My name is Sun Hao. I work at a company.
星期一到星期五，我都很忙。
From Monday to Friday I'm always busy.
早上六点我就起床了。
I get up at six in the morning.
起床以后，我去公园跑步。
After I get up I go running in the park.

What does Sun Hao do after getting up?

passages.title: 火车站怎么走？
sentences: 何静第一次来北京，她想去火车站。
It is He Jing's first time in Beijing, and she wants to go to the railway station.
她不知道怎么走，所以她问路上的一个男人。
She doesn't know the way, so she asks a man in the street.
何静：“您好！请问，火车站怎么走？”
He Jing: "Hello! Excuse me, how do I get to the railway station?"
男人：“火车站？离这儿很远。”
Man: "The railway station? It's a long way from here."
“你可以坐公共汽车，也可以坐出租车。”
"You can take a bus or a taxi."
何静：“走路要多长时间？”
He Jing: "How long does it take on foot?"
男人：“走路要四十多分钟。”
Man: "Over forty minutes on foot."
男人：“你看见前面那个大商店了吗？”
Man: "Do you see that big shop ahead?"
“商店右边就是公共汽车站。”
"The bus stop is just to the right of the shop."
“坐十五路，五站就到火车站了。”
"Take the number 15. It's five stops to the railway station."
何静：“票多少钱？”
He Jing: "How much is the ticket?"
男人：“两块钱。”
Man: "Two yuan."
何静：“谢谢您！”男人：“不客气！”
He Jing: "Thank you!" Man: "You're welcome!"

questions.en: Who does He Jing ask for directions?
It's close from here to the railway station.

questions.q: 走路去火车站要多长时间？
questions.en: How long does it take to walk to the station?
Where is the bus stop?
The bus ticket costs two yuan.

passages.title: 买西瓜
sentences: 我：“您好！西瓜怎么卖？”
Me: "Hello! How much are the watermelons?"
卖水果的：“西瓜三块五一公斤。”
Fruit seller: "Watermelon is 3.5 yuan a kilo."
我：“太贵了！能便宜一些吗？”
Me: "That's too expensive! Can you make it a bit cheaper?"
卖水果的：“这是今天的新西瓜。三块钱一公斤吧。”
Fruit seller: "These watermelons came in today. Three yuan a kilo, then."
我：“好，我要这个大的。”
Me: "OK, I'll take this big one."
卖水果的：“这个西瓜五公斤，十五块钱。”
Fruit seller: "This watermelon is five kilos, fifteen yuan."
我：“我还要两公斤苹果。”
Me: "I'll take two kilos of apples as well."
卖水果的：“好的。一共二十七块。”
Fruit seller: "OK. Twenty-seven yuan altogether."
我给了她三十块，她找了我三块钱。
I gave her thirty yuan and she gave me three yuan change.
西瓜真好吃！
The watermelon was really delicious!

questions.q: 开始的时候，西瓜多少钱一公斤？
questions.en: At first, how much was the watermelon per kilo?

questions.q: 我买西瓜的时候，是每公斤三块。
questions.en: When I bought the watermelon, it was three yuan per kilo.
How many kilos was the watermelon I bought?
What else did I buy?

questions.q: 卖水果的找了我五块钱。
questions.en: The fruit seller gave me five yuan change.

passages.title: 汉语考试
sentences: 明天有汉语考试，今天晚上我在房间里准备。
There's a Chinese exam tomorrow, so tonight I'm preparing in my room.
老师告诉我们，考试有一百个题，要两个小时。
The teacher told us the exam has a hundred questions and takes two hours.
我的朋友陈杰也在我的房间，我们一起学习。
My friend Chen Jie is in my room too, and we study together.
陈杰问我：“这个字是什么意思？”
Chen Jie asks me: "What does this character mean?"
我回答他：“这个字的意思是‘快乐’。”
I answer him: "This character means 'happy'."
我们学习到晚上十一点，非常累。
We study until eleven at night and are very tired.
早上七点，我们起床去教室。
At seven in the morning we get up and go to the classroom.
考试的题不难。
The exam questions aren't difficult.
我觉得我只错了两个题。
I think I only got two questions wrong.
下午，老师告诉我，这次考试我是第一！
In the afternoon the teacher told me I came first in this exam!

questions.en: How long does the exam take?
Chen Jie studies with me.
Until what time do we study?
I think the exam questions are hard.
Whose exam result is first?

passages.title: 在机场
sentences: 星期五晚上，周婷要坐飞机去上海旅游。
On Friday evening Zhou Ting is flying to Shanghai for a trip.
她坐出租车去机场，路上出租车走得很慢。
She took a taxi to the airport, and the taxi went very slowly on the way.
到机场的时候，已经七点了。
When she reached the airport it was already seven.
她的票在手机里，但是她找不到手机了！
Her ticket was on her phone, but she couldn't find her phone!
周婷非常着急。
Zhou Ting was very worried.
一个服务员问她：“您在找什么？”
A member of staff asked her: "What are you looking for?"
周婷告诉她：“我找不到我的手机了。”
Zhou Ting told her: "I can't find my phone."
服务员笑着问：“这个白手机是您的吗？”
The staff member smiled and asked: "Is this white phone yours?"
“它在那个椅子上。”
"It was on that chair."
她八点坐上了去上海的飞机。
At eight she was on the plane to Shanghai.

questions.en: What is Zhou Ting going to Shanghai for?
What did Zhou Ting take to the airport?
Zhou Ting only reached the airport at eight.
What couldn't Zhou Ting find?

questions.q: 周婷的手机在一个椅子上。
questions.en: Zhou Ting's phone was on a chair.

passages.title: 多运动，身体好
sentences: 很多人都知道，多运动，身体就会好。
Many people know that if you exercise more, your health will be good.
但是现在很多人工作很忙，没有时间运动。
But nowadays lots of people are busy with work and have no time to exercise.
每个星期运动三次，每次一个小时，就可以了。
Exercising three times a week, for an hour each time, is enough.
早上起床以后，你可以去跑步。
After getting up in the morning you can go running.
喜欢水的人，可以去游泳。
People who like water can go swimming.
和朋友一起打篮球，也非常快乐。
Playing basketball with friends is also great fun.
晚上不忙的时候，可以出去走走。
In the evening, when you aren't busy, you can go out for a walk.
运动的时候要多喝水。
Drink plenty of water when you exercise.
运动完了，要好好休息。
After exercise, rest well.
开始运动吧！你会觉得身体越来越好。
Start exercising! You'll feel your body getting better and better.

questions.en: Why do many people not exercise?

questions.q: 每个星期运动几次就可以了？
questions.en: How many times a week is enough exercise?
Each session of exercise should last three hours.

questions.q: 运动的时候要多做什么？
questions.en: What should you do more of while exercising?
You should rest well after exercising.

passages.title: 我的家人
sentences: 我姓杨，叫杨欣。
My surname is Yang, and my name is Yang Xin.
我来介绍一下我的家人。
Let me introduce my family.
我家有六个人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、姐姐、弟弟和我。
There are six people in my family: Dad, Mum, my older brother, older sister, younger brother and me.
爸爸在公司上班，妈妈是医生。
Dad works at a company, and Mum is a doctor.
我哥哥二十八岁，他和妻子住在上海。
My older brother is twenty-eight. He lives in Shanghai with his wife.
他的妻子很漂亮，眼睛很大。
His wife is very pretty, with big eyes.
我姐姐是汉语老师，她非常喜欢孩子。
My older sister is a Chinese teacher. She loves children.
弟弟十五岁，他很高，比我高。
My younger brother is fifteen. He's tall, taller than me.
他最喜欢打篮球和游泳。
He likes basketball and swimming best.
我是学生，我喜欢唱歌和跳舞。
I'm a student. I like singing and dancing.
星期日，哥哥和妻子会回家看我们。
On Sundays my brother and his wife come home to see us.

questions.en: How many people are in Yang Xin's family?

questions.q: 杨欣的妈妈做什么工作？
questions.en: What does Yang Xin's mum do?
The older brother's home is in Shanghai.
The younger brother is not as tall as Yang Xin.
What does the younger brother like best?

passages.title: 明天的天气
sentences: 大家好！现在我们来看看明天的天气。
Hello everyone! Now let's look at tomorrow's weather.
明天北京上午晴，下午阴，晚上可能会下雪。
Tomorrow Beijing will be sunny in the morning and cloudy in the afternoon, and it may snow at night.
明天上午不太冷，下午会冷一些。
Tomorrow morning won't be too cold, but the afternoon will be a bit colder.
晚上出门的时候，请大家多穿衣服。
If you go out in the evening, please wear extra clothes.
下雪的时候，走路要慢一些。
When it snows, walk more slowly.
上海明天上午下雨，下午晴。
Tomorrow Shanghai will have rain in the morning and sun in the afternoon.
广州明天很热，出去玩的时候，要多喝水。
Guangzhou will be hot tomorrow. Drink plenty of water when you go out.
这个星期六和星期日，北京的天气都很好，不冷也不热。
This Saturday and Sunday the weather in Beijing will be good, neither cold nor hot.
大家可以出去玩，去公园走走。
You can go out and take a walk in the park.

questions.q: 明天北京下午的天气怎么样？
questions.en: What will Beijing's weather be like tomorrow afternoon?

questions.q: 明天晚上北京可能会下雨。
questions.en: It may rain in Beijing tomorrow night.

questions.q: 晚上出门的时候要做什么？
questions.en: What should people do when they go out in the evening?
It won't rain in Shanghai tomorrow morning.
What will the weather be like in Guangzhou tomorrow?

passages.title: 新饭馆
sentences: 我家旁边开了一个新饭馆。
A new restaurant has opened next to my home.
上个星期六，我和丈夫去那里吃了一次。
Last Saturday my husband and I went there to eat.
饭馆不大，但是很干净。
The restaurant isn't big, but it's very clean.
服务员都笑着欢迎我们。
The staff all welcomed us with smiles.
我们点了羊肉、鱼和米饭。
We ordered lamb, fish and rice.
羊肉非常好吃，鱼也很新鲜。
The lamb was delicious, and the fish was very fresh.
但是米饭不太好吃。
But the rice wasn't very good.
我丈夫喝了咖啡，我喝了牛奶。
My husband had coffee and I had milk.
两个人一共一百五十元，不太贵。
It was 150 yuan for two people altogether, not too expensive.
饭馆离我家很近，走路五分钟就到了。
The restaurant is close to my home, just five minutes on foot.
下次我们还会再来。
We'll come again next time.

questions.en: This restaurant is very big.
What dishes did they order?
I drank milk, not coffee.
How much did the two people spend?

questions.q: 从我家走到饭馆要多长时间？
questions.en: How long does it take to walk from my home to the restaurant?

passages.title: 怎么吃药
sentences: 你好！这是你的药，请你看看怎么吃。
Hello! Here is your medicine. Please read how to take it.
白的药，早上、中午和晚上都要吃，每次吃两个。
Take the white tablets in the morning, at noon and in the evening, two each time.
红的药，晚上睡觉以前吃一个。
Take one red tablet in the evening before bed.
吃药的时候要多喝水，别喝咖啡。
Drink plenty of water with the medicine, and don't drink coffee.
这个星期你要多休息，别去跑步、游泳。
Rest a lot this week, and don't go running or swimming.
你可以吃米饭、鸡蛋和水果，别吃冷的东西。
You can eat rice, eggs and fruit, but don't eat cold food.
晚上十点以前要睡觉。
Go to bed before ten at night.
星期五你的身体还不好，就再来医院看看。
If you're still not well on Friday, come back to the hospital.
祝你身体健康！
I wish you good health!

questions.en: How many white tablets should you take each time?
You take one red tablet each time.
What shouldn't you drink with the medicine?
You can go swimming this week.
Before what time should you go to bed?

passages.title: 我的新房间
sentences: 林娜，你好！我已经住进新房间了。
Hi Lin Na! I've moved into my new room.
新房间离我的公司很近，走路五分钟就到了。
The new room is close to my company, just five minutes on foot.
房间不大，但是很新，门和桌子都是白的。
The room isn't big, but it's new, and the door and table are white.
我旁边的房间住着一个女人，她姓何。
A woman lives in the room next to mine. Her surname is He.
她非常好，每个星期都送我一些水果。
She's very nice and gives me some fruit every week.
我们有时候一起跑步。
Sometimes we go running together.
这个房间一个月两千元，不太贵。
This room is 2,000 yuan a month, not too expensive.
星期六和星期日我都在家，欢迎你来！
I'm home on Saturdays and Sundays. You're welcome to come!

questions.en: The new room is close to the company.

questions.q: 房间的门是什么颜色的？
questions.en: What colour is the door of the room?

questions.q: 我旁边住的是一个男人。
questions.en: The person living next to me is a man.

questions.q: 我和何小姐有时候去游泳。
questions.en: Ms He and I sometimes go swimming.

questions.q: 这个房间一个月多少钱？
questions.en: How much is this room per month?

passages.title: 手表找到了
sentences: 刘芳有一块手表，是她丈夫送给她的生日礼物。
Liu Fang has a watch that her husband gave her as a birthday present.
星期三早上，刘芳起床以后，找不到手表了。
On Wednesday morning, after Liu Fang got up, she couldn't find her watch.
她在房间里找了很长时间，没找到。
She searched her room for a long time but didn't find it.
她问丈夫：“你看见我的手表了吗？”
She asked her husband: "Have you seen my watch?"
丈夫回答：“没看见。你昨天晚上穿的衣服里呢？”
Her husband answered: "No. What about in the clothes you wore last night?"
刘芳找了找，衣服里没有。
Liu Fang looked, but it wasn't in the clothes.
她觉得非常难过。
She felt very upset.
晚上回家，她的儿子笑着告诉她：“妈妈，你的手表在我这儿！”
When she got home in the evening, her son smiled and told her: "Mum, I've got your watch!"
早上儿子在门旁边找到了手表。
That morning her son had found the watch next to the door.

questions.en: Who gave Liu Fang the watch?

questions.q: 刘芳在星期三早上开始找手表。
questions.en: Liu Fang started looking for her watch on Wednesday morning.
Where did her husband suggest Liu Fang look?
Liu Fang's watch was in the clothes.
Where was the watch found?

passages.title: 去上海旅游
sentences: 去年七月，我和爸爸妈妈去上海旅游。
Last July I went to Shanghai on holiday with my mum and dad.
我们坐飞机去。
We flew there.
上海非常大，人非常多。
Shanghai is very big, with a huge number of people.
到上海的第一个晚上，我们就去坐船了。
On our first evening in Shanghai we went on a boat.
在船上，我们看见了很多高高的楼。
From the boat we saw lots of tall buildings.
星期日，我们去了很多商店，妈妈买了很多新衣服。
On Sunday we went to lots of shops, and Mum bought lots of new clothes.
爸爸觉得很累，所以他没有和我们一起去，在房间里休息。
Dad felt tired, so he didn't come with us and rested in the room.
上海菜很甜，但是很好吃。
Shanghai food is sweet but delicious.
我们在上海玩了一个星期。
We spent a week in Shanghai.
我非常快乐，希望还可以再去上海。
I was very happy, and I hope I can go to Shanghai again.

questions.en: How did they get to Shanghai?
There are few people in Shanghai.

questions.q: 他们第一个晚上做什么？
questions.en: What did they do on the first evening?

questions.q: 爸爸没有去商店，他在房间里休息。
questions.en: Dad didn't go to the shops; he rested in the room.

questions.q: 他们在上海玩了多长时间？
questions.en: How long did they spend in Shanghai?

passages.title: 搬家
sentences: 上个月，我们家搬到了一个新地方。
Last month our family moved to a new place.
新家在一个很高的楼里，我们住在十二层。
Our new home is in a tall building. We live on the twelfth floor.
楼里有电梯，所以上下楼很方便。
The building has a lift, so going up and down is easy.
新家比以前的家大，有三个房间和一个很大的厨房。
The new home is bigger than the old one, with three rooms and a very big kitchen.
搬家的时候，爸爸找了几个朋友来帮忙。
When we moved, Dad got a few friends to help.
他们把冰箱、空调和桌子都搬上了楼。
They carried the fridge, the air conditioner and the tables upstairs.
妈妈在新厨房里给大家做了面条。
Mum made noodles for everyone in the new kitchen.
我们的邻居是一位老奶奶，她非常热情。
Our neighbour is an old lady, and she is very warm and friendly.
她送给我们一些自己做的面包。
She gave us some bread she had made herself.

questions.en: Which floor is the new home on?

questions.q: 这个楼上下很方便，因为有电梯。
questions.en: Going up and down this building is easy because there is a lift.
How many rooms does the new home have?

questions.q: 搬家的时候，谁来帮忙了？
questions.en: Who came to help with the move?

questions.q: 邻居送的面包是在超市买的。
questions.en: The bread the neighbour gave was bought at a supermarket.

passages.title: 周末去爬山
sentences: 这个周末天气很好，我和同事徐伟一起去爬山。
The weather was lovely this weekend, so my colleague Xu Wei and I went hiking in the hills.
我们早上七点坐地铁，一个多小时就到了。
We took the underground at seven in the morning and got there in just over an hour.
出门以前，我们准备了很多东西：水、面包、香蕉和照相机。
Before leaving we got lots of things ready: water, bread, bananas and a camera.
开始爬山的时候，我们觉得很容易。
When we started climbing we found it easy.
但是一个小时以后，我们又累又渴。
But an hour later we were tired and thirsty.
我们在树下休息了一会儿，喝了很多水。
We rested under a tree for a while and drank lots of water.
徐伟把面包和香蕉拿出来，我们一边吃一边看地图。
Xu Wei took out the bread and bananas, and we ate while looking at the map.
下午一点，我们终于到了最高的地方。
At one in the afternoon we finally reached the highest point.
我们决定下个月再去一次。
We decided to go again next month.

questions.q: 他们怎么去爬山的地方？
questions.en: How did they get to the hiking spot?
They brought bread and bananas.

questions.q: 爬山一个小时以后，他们觉得怎么样？
questions.en: How did they feel after an hour of climbing?

questions.q: 他们一边吃东西，一边看地图。
questions.en: They looked at the map while eating.

questions.q: 他们几点到了最高的地方？
questions.en: What time did they reach the highest point?

passages.title: 我的爱好
sentences: 我最大的爱好是音乐。
My biggest hobby is music.
我从小就喜欢听音乐，也喜欢唱歌。
I've loved listening to music since I was little, and I like singing too.
我还喜欢画画，我画的熊猫很可爱，我的朋友都很喜欢。
I also like drawing. The pandas I draw are cute, and my friends all like them.
以前我也很喜欢玩电脑游戏，周末一玩就是五六个小时。
I used to love computer games too. At weekends I'd play for five or six hours at a time.
妈妈很生气，她认为游戏对眼睛不好。
Mum got angry. She thinks games are bad for the eyes.
最近我对体育也有了兴趣。
Recently I've also become interested in sport.
每个星期六，我都和同学去打篮球。
Every Saturday I play basketball with my classmates.
下个月学校要举行比赛，我们班也会参加。
Next month the school is holding a competition, and our class will take part.
练习的时候我非常认真，因为我希望我们班能赢。
I practise very seriously because I hope our class can win.

questions.en: What is my biggest hobby?

questions.q: 我画的熊猫，朋友都很喜欢。
questions.en: My friends all like the pandas I draw.
Why did Mum get angry?
What do I do every Saturday?

questions.q: 我们班不参加下个月的比赛。
questions.en: Our class isn't taking part in next month's competition.

passages.title: 感冒了
sentences: 何静感冒了，还有一点发烧。
He Jing has a cold and a slight fever.
星期二下午，她去医院检查身体。
On Tuesday afternoon she went to the hospital for a check-up.
医生问她哪里不舒服，何静回答：“我的鼻子不舒服，脚和腿也很疼。”
The doctor asked her what was wrong. He Jing answered: "My nose feels bad, and my feet and legs ache too."
医生检查以后，告诉她：“你感冒了，没什么大问题。”
After the examination the doctor told her: "You have a cold. It's nothing serious."
“这个药每次吃两个，早上一次，晚上一次。”
"Take two of these tablets each time, once in the morning and once in the evening."
“你要多喝水，多休息，最近别去锻炼了。”
"Drink plenty of water, rest a lot, and don't exercise for now."
“如果还发烧，你就马上回来。”
"If you still have a fever, come back straight away."
何静问：“我明天可以去上班吗？”
He Jing asked: "Can I go to work tomorrow?"
医生回答：“你应该在家里休息，别去上班。”
The doctor answered: "You should rest at home and not go to work."
星期五，她的感冒终于好了。
On Friday her cold was finally better.

questions.en: Which day did He Jing go to the hospital?
He Jing's nose is fine.
How many tablets should she take each time?
The doctor agrees that He Jing can go to work.

questions.q: 何静的感冒星期几好了？
questions.en: On which day did He Jing's cold get better?

passages.title: 图书馆的新要求
sentences: 大家好！从下个星期一开始，学校图书馆有一些新要求。
Hello everyone! From next Monday the school library has some new rules.
图书馆的时间是早上八点到晚上十点，周末下午五点关门。
The library is open from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m., and closes at 5 p.m. at weekends.
每个学生一次可以借十本书，借书时间是一个月。
Each student can borrow ten books at a time, for one month.
书借了一个月以后，必须还给图书馆。
After a month, borrowed books must be returned to the library.
字典和历史书只能在图书馆里看，不能借回家。
Dictionaries and history books can only be read in the library and cannot be taken home.
图书馆里必须安静，请不要打电话，也请把手机的声音关了。

passages.title: 我的城市
sentences: 我住的城市在中国北方，这十年变化非常大。
The city I live in is in northern China, and it has changed enormously in the last ten years.
现在城市里有了很多高楼，街道也比以前干净多了。
Now the city has lots of tall buildings, and the streets are much cleaner than before.
以前城市里没有地铁，大家都骑自行车或者坐公共汽车。
There used to be no underground, so everyone rode bikes or took the bus.
现在有了五条地铁，去哪儿都很方便。
Now there are five underground lines, and it's easy to get anywhere.
城市里还有很多新公园，公园里有花、有草、有树，环境越来越好。

很多老人早上在公园里锻炼身体。

北方的冬天非常冷，夏天很热。

Autumn is neither cold nor hot. It's the best season here.

What did the city not have before?

questions.q: 现在这个城市有几条地铁？

questions.q: 老人一般晚上去公园锻炼身体。

passages.title: 去看熊猫

oop.竹子: bamboo; what pandas eat, the pack has no word for it

sentences: 上个周末，我和女儿去成都看熊猫。
Last weekend my daughter and I went to Chengdu to see the pandas.
我们早上八点就到了，那里的人已经很多了。
We got there at eight in the morning, and there were already lots of people.
有的熊猫在树上睡觉，有的在草地上玩。
Some pandas were sleeping in the trees, and some were playing on the grass.
有一只熊猫从树上下来，走得很慢，非常可爱。
One panda climbed down from a tree. It walked very slowly and was very cute.
女儿问我：“熊猫最喜欢吃什么？”
My daughter asked me: "What do pandas like to eat most?"
我告诉她：“熊猫吃竹子，也吃一些水果。”
I told her: "Pandas eat bamboo, and some fruit too."
那里的一位阿姨告诉我们，熊猫一般很少运动，很爱睡觉。
A woman who worked there told us that pandas usually move very little and love sleeping.
回家以后，女儿把熊猫的照片给她的朋友看。
After we got home, my daughter showed the panda photos to her friends.
她告诉我，她长大以后想照顾熊猫。
She told me that when she grows up she wants to look after pandas.

questions.en: Who did I go to see the pandas with?

questions.q: 女儿长大以后想做什么？

passages.title: 奶奶的故事
sentences: 我的奶奶已经八十岁了，但是她的身体还很健康。
My grandma is eighty, but she is still very healthy.
我还很小的时候，奶奶经常给我讲故事。
When I was very small, Grandma often told me stories.
我最喜欢听她讲她和爷爷的故事。
My favourite was the story of her and Grandpa.

有一次，奶奶在河旁边洗衣服，她的帽子掉进了河里。

一个年轻人看见了，马上进了河里，把帽子拿了回来。

那个年轻人就是我的爷爷。

But these days environmental pollution is getting worse and worse.
很多城市的空气质量不好，河里的水也越来越脏。

首先，要节约用水，离开房间的时候，记得关灯和空调。

其次，去超市购物的时候，最好少用塑料袋。

Also, don't drop litter everywhere; put it in the bin.

保护环境其实不难，关键是要坚持。

后来，我认识了一个中国朋友，她叫林娜。

她想去法国留学，所以我们经常互相帮助。

特别是上下班的时间，路上经常堵车，有时候一公里要走半个小时。
Especially at rush hour the roads are often jammed, and sometimes one kilometre takes half an hour.
为了解决这个问题，城市做了很多努力。
The city has made a lot of effort to solve this problem.
首先，修了更多的地铁，地铁速度快，而且很准时。

我们决定送他一块好手表，还要请所有的亲戚来家里，一起为他过生日。

我们到的时候是早上九点，但是长城上的人已经很多了。

我们去的那一段比较难走，很多地方又高又窄，走起来很累。

朋友一直鼓励我：“坚持一下，前面的风景更美丽！”
My friends kept encouraging me: "Keep going, the view ahead is even better!"
我们终于到了最高的地方，风景果然非常美丽。

阅读不仅能帮助我们积累词语，而且能让我们了解更多的知识。
Reading not only helps us build vocabulary but also lets us learn more.
如果遇到困难，千万不要放弃，可以去问老师和同学。
If you run into difficulties, never give up; ask your teachers and classmates.
最后，要注意休息，保证每个晚上至少有七个小时的睡觉时间。
Finally, make sure you rest, with at least seven hours of sleep every night.
只要方法正确，并且能坚持，你的成绩一定会提高。

sentences: 现在，很多年轻人都想减肥。
Nowadays many young people want to lose weight.
有的人为了让自己瘦一些，几乎不吃东西。
Some people barely eat anything to get thinner.
其实，这种方法对身体很不好。
In fact, this approach is very bad for your health.
医生认为，减肥最重要的是吃得健康，还要多运动。
Doctors say the most important thing in losing weight is to eat healthily and exercise more.
首先，要少吃甜的东西，例如巧克力、蛋糕和饼干。
First, eat fewer sweet things, such as chocolate, cake and biscuits.
饮料里一般有很多糖，所以最好多喝水，少喝饮料。
Soft drinks usually contain a lot of sugar, so it's best to drink more water and fewer soft drinks.
其次，菜不要太咸，也不要太辣，盐要少放。
Second, food shouldn't be too salty or too spicy; use less salt.
可以多吃水果、鸡蛋和鱼。
You can eat more fruit, eggs and fish.
另外，吃东西的速度不要太快，吃到七八分饱就停止。
Also, don't eat too fast, and stop when you're about 70 to 80 percent full.
除了注意吃，还要坚持锻炼，例如跑步、游泳或者散步。
Besides watching what you eat, keep exercising, for example running, swimming or walking.
减肥需要时间，不能太着急。
Losing weight takes time, so don't be impatient.
只有吃得健康、多运动，才能真正又瘦又健康。
